      - text: In this help doc
      - heading "Notion is first and foremost a writing tool. It works as simply as any word processor, only you can add many different types of content to a page, and move it around and modify it in new ways." [level=2]
      - link "Jump to FAQs":
        - /url: /help/writing-and-editing-basics#faq
      - separator
      - article:
        - heading "Editing tools" [level=2]:
          - link "Editing tools":
            - /url: /help/writing-and-editing-basics#editing-tools
          - img
        - paragraph: There are three tools to familiarize yourself with in order to create any page you want.
        - list:
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - strong:
                - code: +
              - strong: "icon:"
              - text: Appears in the left margin whenever you hover over a new line. Click it to open a menu of content types you can add to your page.
        - button "Open lightbox":
          - figure
        - list:
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - strong:
                - code: ⋮⋮
              - strong: "icon:"
              - text: "This appears in the left margin whenever you hover over a new line or content block. Click and drag to move a block. Or click it to open a menu of actions. For example:"
            - list:
              - listitem:
                - paragraph:
                  - code: Turn into
                  - text: ": Transforms the block into another type of block (like a bullet into a checkbox, or plain text into a heading), or into a page."
              - listitem:
                - paragraph:
                  - code: Color
                  - text: ": Only appears for certain types of blocks to turn them into a different color or give them a background color — like text, files, and web bookmarks."
              - listitem:
                - paragraph:
                  - code: Copy link to block
                  - text: ": Copies the anchor link to this particular block."
              - listitem:
                - paragraph:
                  - code: Duplicate
                  - text: ": Makes an exact copy of the content block."
              - listitem:
                - paragraph:
                  - code: Move to
                  - text: ": Moves the block to another page in your workspace."
              - listitem:
                - paragraph:
                  - code: Delete
                  - text: ": Deletes the block."
              - listitem:
                - paragraph:
                  - code: Comment
                  - text: ": Lets you add a comment to the block."
              - listitem:
                - paragraph:
                  - code: Suggest edits
                  - text: ": Lets you make a suggestion on the block."
              - listitem:
                - paragraph:
                  - code: Ask AI
                  - text: ": Lets you ask Notion AI anything, or take actions on your block using Notion AI."
              - listitem:
                - paragraph:
                  - code: Word and character count
                  - text: ": When you select one or more blocks, the menu shows how many words and characters are in your selection."
        - button "Open lightbox":
          - figure:
            - img "Block handle"
        - list:
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - code: /
              - strong: "menu and commands:"
              - text: The easiest way to both add content to your page or apply any of the actions above (essentially a shortcut for the same functionality of the
              - code: +
              - text: and
              - code: ⋮⋮
              - text: menus).
            - list:
              - listitem:
                - paragraph:
                  - text: Type
                  - code: /
                  - text: "followed by any type of block to add it. Examples:"
                  - code: /bullet
                  - text: or
                  - code: /heading
                  - text: .
              - listitem:
                - paragraph:
                  - text: Type
                  - code: /
                  - text: "followed by any action to apply it to the block. Examples:"
                  - code: /delete
                  - text: or
                  - code: /duplicate
                  - text: .
              - listitem:
                - paragraph:
                  - text: Type
                  - code: /
                  - text: followed by the name of any color to change the color of the block. Like
                  - code: /red
                  - text: .
              - listitem:
                - paragraph:
                  - text: Typing
                  - code: /
                  - text: will bring up a menu of
                  - link "block types":
                    - /url: https://www.notion.com/help/what-is-a-block
                  - text: — all of your options for the type of content you can create in Notion. As you experiment with block types, you’ll find a combination of your most used and your recently used blocks at the top of the menu for quick and easy access.
        - button "Open lightbox":
          - figure
        - heading "Types of content" [level=2]:
          - link "Types of content":
            - /url: /help/writing-and-editing-basics#types-of-content
          - img
        - paragraph:
          - text: There are many different types of content blocks you can add to Notion, from bullet points to images to embeds to math equations. Here's a full list of content types, split into the same categories you'll find in our block menu (which can be opened with
          - code: /
          - text: or
          - code: +
          - text: ).
        - heading "Basic blocks" [level=3]:
          - link "Basic blocks":
            - /url: /help/writing-and-editing-basics#basic-blocks
          - img
        - list:
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - code: Text
              - text: ": Just your regular old plain text!"
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - code: Page
              - text: ": Adds a sub-page inside your page. You can put pages inside pages inside pages."
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - code: To-do list
              - text: ": Checkboxes for tasks and such. Shortcut"
              - code: "[]"
              - text: .
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - code: Heading 1
              - text: ": The largest heading, can be easily added with shortcut"
              - code: /h1
              - text: .
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - code: Heading 2
              - text: ": The medium-sized heading, can be easily added with shortcut"
              - code: /h2
              - text: .
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - code: Heading 3
              - text: ": The smallest heading, can be easily added with shortcut"
              - code: /h3
              - text: .
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - code: "Table:"
              - text: Creates a simple set of columns and rows.
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - code: Bulleted list
              - text: ": Bullets. Shortcut"
              - code: "-"
              - text: +
              - code: space
              - text: .
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - code: Numbered list
              - text: ": Indents your list and automatically generates the next number."
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - code: Toggle list
              - text: ": Creates a toggle that can contain other content, and can be opened or closed. You can create a toggle using the shortcut"
              - code: ">"
              - text: +
              - code: space
              - text: . At this time, you’ll need to open and close toggles manually — there’s no way to open and close them all at once, or make them open or closed by default.
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - code: Quote
              - text: ": Creates larger text to break quotes out from the rest of your document."
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - code: Divider
              - text: ": Creates a thin gray line to break up text. Shortcut"
              - code: "---"
              - text: .
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - code: Link to page
              - text: ": Creates a block that's a link to another page in your workspace."
          - listitem:
            - paragraph:
              - code: Callout
              - text: ": Creates boxed text for tips, warnings, disclaimers, etc. With emoji!"
        - heading "Database" [level=3]:
          - link "Database":
            - /url: /help/writing-and-editing-basics#database
